findings.claim: The observed window is the score-time interval [0.0,0.5] with 50 observed score nodes at 0.01 spacing, and the label semantics are recorded affinities removed under an equal score prior; the coordinate representation is native model endpoint world coordinates.

The declared objective is final predicted target affinity primary with validity and strain secondary, coordinate control only; this fixes the endpoint pointcloud reward as the primary target and makes any coordinate contrast a diagnostic rather than an absolute reward target.

Across the first six landmark_00 continuous features, no polynomial fit is accepted (polynomial_accepted false for all), all are restricted to observed-node linear interpolation with extrapolation disallowed, and relative node RMSE ranges from about 0.29 to 0.78, so the supplied evidence does not support a smooth time-conditioned coordinate rule for these features.

These landmark_00 features show repeated sign changes (4 to 10) and strong sign conflicts (1 to 9) with first-rate and last-rate z values of opposite sign (e.g. landmark_00_local_dx first_rate_z negative and last_rate_z positive), which is counterevidence against a stable signed direction for these local coordinate descriptors.

Whole-window z values for these landmark_00 features are small in magnitude (about 0.02 to 0.64) and mixed in sign, so the whole-window mean contrast does not establish a consistent favorable-versus-comparison direction at these nodes.

hypotheses.direction: descriptive only; no registered reward recipe is supported by these rows
hypotheses.falsifier: A validated fit or observed-node interpolation with consistent sign and low relative node RMSE across independent batches would weaken this descriptive limitation.
hypotheses.observable: landmark_00 local coordinate features over observed score nodes
hypotheses.statement: A time-conditioned coordinate rule for landmark_00 local descriptors would be preferred over a constant rule only if a validated fit or observed-node interpolation shows a reproducible signed contrast across the observed window; the supplied rows show no accepted polynomial and conflicting rate signs, so a constant rule is not yet outperformed.

limitations: Only the first six continuous_trends rows and the clocks/objective metadata were read; the remaining 194 continuous features, branch_adjusted, joint_diagnostics, regional_effects, survival_effects, increment_effects and turnover_accounting tables were not inspected, so no population-contrast, coupling, or turnover conclusion is asserted.

No independent-batch agreement or opposing-observation check beyond the reported sign_changes and strong_sign_conflicts fields was performed, so reproducibility of any coordinate direction is not established.
The supplied evidence does not include current study outcome data, so no claim about affinity improvement or neural-module causation is made.
No temperature edit is proposed or considered; temperatures are immutable task parameters.
